title: Patch handoff lite census and shift buckets
body:
Purpose: quick lightweight tracker to apportion short-notice patch handoffs across squads and estimate incremental hour/cost exposure. Not a PMR; this is a ‘who-does-what-today/next-72h’ census for ad-hoc coverage slots.

Context and constraints:
- Patch window expected: rolling 72h window starting 2029-08-20 00:00 UTC.
- This is a low-complexity patch (lib update + config toggle) but can trigger fallthrough incidents if prefix cache mismatch occurs.
- Priority: minimize cross-team churn, prefer on-call owners in-window, keep 0–2 dedicated mitigators per region.
- Quick cost calc uses $90/hr blended ops+eng rate for short bursts.

High-level shift buckets (for spreadsheet view):
- BUCKET A (Primary): 4h contiguous blocks, owners must be able to run commands and triage on-call alerts.
- BUCKET B (Secondary): 6h flexible, backup hands for escalations, validate rollbacks.
- BUCKET C (Overflow): advisory only, vendor/partner contacts and runbook watchers.

Snapshot table (rows are the sheet rows):
- Row headers: owner | team | region | bucket | primary-window (UTC) | backup | est-hours | notes | cost-flag
- Aisha Patel | company-ops | us-east | A | 2029-08-20 00:00-04:00 | Liam Chen | 4 | runbook lead; preflight checklist holder | yes
- Liam Chen | infra | us-west | A | 2029-08-20 04:00-08:00 | Sofia Martinez | 4 | will handle GPU infra validation; watch KV cache | yes
- Sofia Martinez | serving-runtime | eu-west | B | 2029-08-20 08:00-14:00 | Devon O'Neill | 6 | focus on runtime binary compatibility, quick rollback plan | yes
- Devon O'Neill | platform-engineering | ap-south | B | 2029-08-20 14:00-20:00 | Nadia Gomez | 6 | network edge checks, routing smoke tests | yes
- Nadia Gomez | solutions-eng | us-central | C | 2029-08-20 20:00-23:59 | vendor-oncall | 3 | partner validation and docs QA | no
- vendor-oncall | external | global | C | 2029-08-21 00:00-06:00 | - | 6 | vendor will monitor integration telemetry | no

Quick totals and cost snapshot (auto-calc cells in original sheet):
- Total estimated ops hours (72h window): 29
- Blended hourly rate: $90/hr
- One-off labor cost estimate: $2,610
- Contingency buffer (30%): $783 -> total budgeted: $3,393

Coverage risk flags (quick columns):
- RISK-1: KV cache mismatch on short sequence lengths — mitigation: pre-populate cache with synthetic prefixes (owner: serving-runtime).
- RISK-2: Regional fallback misroute during toggles — mitigation: staged toggle with 10% sampled traffic (owner: platform-engineering).
- RISK-3: Incidental partner API quota — mitigation: throttle test run & partner coord window (owner: solutions-eng).

Short action checklist (one-liners):
- Preflight: confirm roll-forward artifact in registry and SHA in ticket (Aisha).
- Canary plan: schedule 10% sample at t+15m, 50% at t+45m, open for rollback at any step (Liam).
- Runbooks: owners to confirm runbook links + quick play summary in the sheet before handoff (Sofia).
- Pager config: ensure escalation path includes on-call + backup with paging delay 2m (Devon).
- Postmortem: light 1-pager required if >15m P99 latency or any error-rate spike >1% sustained >10m (Nadia).

Open questions / TODOs (sticky, informal):
- Vendor contract: can vendor accept a 6h oncall window with immediate paging? (Sofia to confirm).
- Can we reduce blended rate assumption for internal-only hours? Finance check pending (Aisha).
- Do we want a small dedicated alert filter tag for this rollout to reduce noise? If yes, request via Observability (Devon).

Notes to self (rough):
- Keep this sheet intentionally minimal — this is for fast triage only. No need for long-form SRE runbook here. Link to canonical playbook instead.
- If an incident escalates beyond quick rollback, convert this doc into a full incident ticket and let PMR own postmortem.

Proposed next steps and owners:
- 2029-08-16: Finalize owners & windows -> Aisha (assign in calendar).
- 2029-08-17: Preflight dry-run for prefills and smoke tests -> Liam + Sofia.
- 2029-08-19: Confirm vendor readiness and pager config -> Sofia + Nadia.
- 2029-08-20: Patch window (start) -> all owners standing by.

Version notes: initial draft 2029-08-12; small owner swaps and cost update 2029-08-15.

References and helpful links: see linked_artifacts above and shorthand link: confluence/patch-playbook -> high-level playbook; JIRA-OPS-4217 -> patch ticket; MR-1839 -> build that contains the update.

If you’re editing: add a new row for any owner swaps and increment the est-hours cell. Keep the sheet alive until +7d to capture post-rollout notes.
